title.zh-CN: 心脏手术多年后再次晕厥 · 28岁女性
title.en: Recurrent syncope years after cardiac surgery · 28-year-old female

summary.zh-CN: 围绕心脏手术多年后再次晕厥，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for recurrent syncope years after cardiac surgery.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分心源性晕厥与尿失禁的非特异性。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise incontinence as nonspecific when evaluating cardiac syncope.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别 QT 延长和低钾的风险组合。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the risk combination of prolonged QT and hypokalaemia.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出术后复发的综合风险评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Propose integrated reassessment after postoperative recurrence.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免由诱因直接推定基因型。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid assigning genotype from a trigger alone.

text.zh-CN: 原团队给予补钾镁、复律及重新使用普萘洛尔；稳定时 QTc 0.61 s，住院 11 天后出院，随访 1 年余无晕厥。此为历史处置，不提供自行用药剂量。
text.en: The source used electrolyte correction, shocks and resumed propranolol. Stable QTc remained 0.61 s; discharge followed 11 days and no syncope was reported over a year. This is historical care, not a self-dosing plan.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: LCSD 后仍可复发长 QT 相关室速；持续预防与个体化风险评估重要。
conclusion.en: Long-QT ventricular arrhythmia can recur after LCSD; ongoing prevention and individual risk assessment remain important.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 结构正常不排除离子通道疾病。
keyReasoning.en: Normal structure does not exclude a channelopathy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: ESC 2022 强调电解质、诱因及专科防猝死评估。
keyReasoning.en: ESC 2022 supports electrolyte, trigger and specialist sudden-death risk assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 症状缓解不等于 QT 正常。
keyReasoning.en: Symptom remission does not imply a normal QT.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
